answer: Admission auction: each epoch opens only 1,000 slots; each agent must win one with a refundable 50 POA bid. The tide of bids sets the clearing price, so fakes raise it for all. An agent that tries to wander between wallets must win a fresh slot and pay again. Honest agents pay once, keep their ember alive, and get the deposit back. 100 fakes cost 100 bids: 5,000 POA locked. One honest agent pays 50 POA once and earns steady rewards.
